## Upgrading to 5.6

### Rust library

- `TileSchema` has two new variants, so an exhaustive `match` needs new arms: `Custom(String)`, for a well-formed `tile_schema` this version doesn't know, and `VectorVersatilesLandcover1_0`, for `versatiles/landcover@1.0`.
- `TileSchema` is no longer `Copy`, and it no longer works with `EnumSet`. Use `as_ref()` or `clone()` where a value was copied.
- `TileSchema::try_from` now accepts any lowercase `<family>[/<subtype>][@<version>]`, where it used to return an error. Use `is_known()` to tell these values apart.

### Changes that do not announce themselves

- A well-formed `tile_schema` that versatiles doesn't know is now kept when reading, converting and serving. It used to be replaced with a guess from the tiles, so `convert` could change what a tileset declared. A malformed value is still dropped with a warning when read.
- `meta_update schema=` accepts such a value with a warning. It used to be an error, so a typo in a schema name no longer stops the pipeline.
- `raster_overscale` refuses an unknown `dem/…` schema. Such a value never reached it before.
- A vector tileset that declares no schema, and whose only layer is `landcover` with `kind` as its only field, is now detected as `versatiles/landcover@1.0`. It used to be `other`.
